question: Kalamandalam Ramankutty Nair was awarded the Padma Bhushan for his contribution to which dance style?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathakali.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kathakali** is a **classical dance form of Kerala,** India, which is known for its **elaborate costumes, makeup, and gestures.**
 
• It is a combination of** dance, music, and acting**, and is based on themes from **Hindu mythology.**
 
• **Raman Kutty Nair **was a renowned **Kathakali dancer and teacher,** who contributed significantly to the promotion and development of this art form.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Bhushan in 1992** for his contributions to Kathakali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lavani** is a folk dance form o**f Maharashtra, **which is performed by** women** to the accompaniment of music played on** dholki, tasha, and other instruments.**

 
 
• It is known for its **energetic and sensual movements.**
 
 
 
• **Kathak **is a classical dance form of **North India, **which is characterized by intricate footwork, graceful movements, and storytelling through facial expressions and gestures.
 
• **Manipuri** is a classical dance form of** Manipur, **which is known for its slow and graceful movements, and its themes are based on the stories of **Radha and Krishna.**
